Widget family: PANEL / VIEW (containers)

Strict visual criteria (PASS only if ALL hold):

1. A solid rectangular surface is visible (panel background distinct from the canvas clear color when contrast is expected).
2. Edges are coherent (no torn half-filled regions, no random missing corner chunks).
3. Nested children (if claimed) sit inside the panel content box, not outside its border.
4. FAIL if: fully transparent/missing surface when a panel is claimed, or children clearly overflow the panel chrome.
